entity_observations.manual_document_review: The supplied D contains an anonymous first-person reporting entity, contract manufacturers, suppliers, landlords and customers, but no named issuer and no text linking that issuer to Nimbus Corp.
entity_observations.source_quotes_only_support: The Less current portion row supports the numeric cell, reporting unit and local lease-obligation metric, not the issuer name.
entity_observations.audit_limit: supported here confirms lexical/table-coordinate support; it is not an independent proof that the anonymous issuer equals Nimbus.

audit_only_native_source_match.native_question: what is the current portion of the present value of lease obligations?
audit_only_native_source_match.not_present_in_model_inputs: The native ANET filename/company-source identity is audit provenance, not text supplied in D or an input to the model. It must not be used as a label oracle to repair this prediction.

old_supplemental_policy.text: 'Resolve ordinary document references in the supplied focal entity scope: the unqualified reporting entity "the company" may refer to the company named by the query/variable when the passage has no competing referent. Explain that reference mapping in notes; never overwrite an explicitly different company, subsidiary or category, and abstain if the reference is ambiguous. '
old_supplemental_policy.verdict: Overbroad: query focal name plus no competing referent licenses an identity link absent from D. No competing issuer is absence of contradiction, not positive evidence of identity.

paper_basis.rule: A numeric answer requires a document-grounded valid derivation; missing/ambiguous context requires abstention.
OES evidence must match metric and temporal/entity/meta constraints; ambiguous or conflicting scope must be missing.

identifiability.observable_from_QD: The specifically named requested issuer is not grounded in D. Under a strict evidence-only task this is sufficient to leave the entity scope unresolved and abstain.
identifiability.not_observable_from_QD: The inputs do not prove that the anonymous issuer is a different company. The same Q/D could be paired with a genuinely Nimbus-owned excerpt or a mismatched excerpt. The counterfactual mismatch itself is not identifiable without trusted source identity.
identifiability.benchmark_label_policy: Keep unanswerable=true and the R25 failed-abstention score unchanged. Do not reclassify the sample, drop it from denominators, or claim the published mismatch is directly visible.

minimal_future_proposal_not_applied.replace_static_reference_rule: Resolve we/our/the company to a specific entity only after the provided document or explicitly supplied trusted document-source identity establishes that reporting entity. A query name is a constraint, not its own evidence. No competing referent alone does not establish identity. If a specifically named requested issuer has no source anchor, report unresolved entity scope in OES notes/missing_vars; do not claim an explicitly contradictory issuer unless one is actually supplied.
preserve_valid_cases: Generic reporter questions can use the unique anonymous we/our reporter without inventing a proper name.
Named issuer passages, source-supported aliases and already-established reporting-entity references remain valid.
Explicit company/subsidiary/category or period conflicts still cannot be overwritten.
minimal_future_proposal_not_applied.optional_audit_improvement: Keep numeric/table support separate from entity-reference support in audit provenance; a copied constraints.entity_scope field is not an evidence span. This is an audit distinction, not another LLM judge or post-hoc answer retry.
minimal_future_proposal_not_applied.trusted_metadata_limit: Only actual, pre-existing document-source identity supplied uniformly as evidence can anchor an issuer. No counterfactual label, sample id, hidden original-company lookup or benchmark answer may be promoted into runtime proof.

tradeoffs.expected_benefit: A strict named-entity anchor rule reduces unsupported acceptance of entity-swapped questions with anonymous excerpts.
tradeoffs.expected_cost: Legitimate named-company questions paired with decontextualized anonymous financial excerpts may then be refused. No Q/D-only method can distinguish all such legitimate cases from entity swaps when the issuer link has been removed.
tradeoffs.mitigation: Preserve anonymous-reporter questions and source-established coreference. If the evaluation truly assumes document ownership, expose that trusted provenance consistently and disclose the input contract; do not silently assume that a question name supplies ownership.
tradeoffs.accuracy_claim: No numeric improvement or new error rate is estimated from this read-only audit.
